Title: Product Philosophy
Requirement text: 2.3 Product Philosophy Every feature developed within the platform must contribute to one or more of the following principles: • Increase operational clarity. • Reduce manual work. • Improve decision-making. • Strengthen organizational security. • Standardize operational processes. • Support sustainable business growth. • Maintain enterprise-grade reliability. • Preserve data integrity and organizational isolation. Features that do not contribute to these objectives should not be included in the platform. C H A P T E R 3 3. Product Principles The following principles apply to every module within the platform. PP-001 Security by Default Security is the default behaviour of the platform. Every feature must follow the principle of least privilege. PP-002 Human Oversight Artificial Intelligence may generate recommendations, summaries, analyses, and draft content. Artificial Intelligence shall never perform irreversible business actions without explicit human authorization unless explicitly configured by the Super Admin. PP-003 Organization Isolation Every organization operates within a completely isolated environment. No user may access data belonging to another organization under any circumstance. PP-004 Single Source of Truth Business information must exist in one authoritative location only. Duplicate business data should be avoided wherever possible. PP-005 Role-Based Access Control Access to every feature, module, and dataset shall be determined by assigned roles and permissions. Users never manually select which portal to access after authentication. PP-006 Complete Auditability Every security-sensitive or business-critical action performed within the platform must be recorded in an immutable audit log. PP-007 Enterprise First The platform shall be designed for organizations with multiple departments, multiple users, and future scalability without requiring architectural redesign. PP-008 Consistency User experience, terminology, navigation, permissions, workflows, and visual behaviour must remain consistent across all modules. C H A P T E R 4 4. Global Business Rules Purpose This section defines the mandatory business rules that apply across the entire IO SKY Platform. These rules are platform-wide requirements and take precedence over individual module specifications. Every module, workflow, integration, AI process, and user interaction must comply with these business rules. Authentication & Identity BR-001 Authentication Required Only authenticated users may access protected platform resources. Public users may only access publicly available website pages. BR-002 Single Identity Each user shall have only one active account within the platform. Multiple accounts for the same individual within the same Organization are not permitted. BR-003 Automatic Portal Routing Users shall never manually select a portal after authentication. Following successful authentication, the platform shall automatically redirect the user to the appropriate portal based on their assigned role and permissions. BR-004 Invitation-Based Access Public account registration is not permitted. User accounts may only be created through approved platform workflows, including: • AI Scan purchase • Admin invitation • Super Admin invitation • Approved customer onboarding • Organization & Multi-Tenancy BR-005 Organization Ownership Every user must belong to at least one Organization. No user may exist without an associated Organization unless explicitly designated as a platform-level user (e.g., Super Admin). BR-006 Organization Isolation Organizations must remain completely isolated. Users shall never be able to access information belonging to another Organization. This applies to all platform data, including projects, reports, invoices, AI Scans, files, messages, and notifications. BR-007 Data Ownership All business records shall belong to exactly one Organization. This includes, but is not limited to: • AI Scans • Reports • Projects • Files • Messages • Invoices • Notifications • Tasks • CRM records AI Business Rules BR-008 AI Supports Human Decision-Making Artificial Intelligence is designed to assist users by generating recommendations, analyses, summaries, and draft content. AI shall not replace human decision-making for business-critical actions. BR-009 Human Approval Required Any AI-generated report intended for customer use must be reviewed and explicitly approved by an authorized IO SKY reviewer before publication. AI-generated reports shall never be published automatically. BR-010 AI Transparency Whenever content has been generated or substantially modified by AI, the platform shall retain metadata indicating its origin for auditing purposes. Communication BR-011 Customer Communication Clients shall never communicate directly with Developers through the platform. All customer communication shall be managed by Admins or Super Admins. BR-012 Internal Communication Developers may communicate internally with Admins, Super Admins, and authorized Technical Operators only. Security BR-013 Least Privilege Every user shall receive only the minimum permissions required to perform their responsibilities. BR-014 Multi-Factor Authentication Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) shall be mandatory for: • Super Admin • Admin • Technical Operator • Developers are strongly encouraged to enable • MFA. Clients may be required to enable MFA based on security policies or access to sensitive information. BR-015 Session Security Users shall be able to review active sessions, revoke sessions, and securely sign out from all devices. Reporting BR-016 Report Lifecycle Every report shall follow the same lifecycle: • Draft • AI Processing • Expert Review • Approved • Published • Archived (optional) Reports may only become visible to Clients after reaching the Published status. BR-017 Version Control Every published report shall retain version history. Previous versions must remain available for authorized administrative users. Projects BR-018 Project Ownership Every project must have: • One owning Organization • One responsible Admin • One current status • Developers may only access projects explicitly assigned to them. BR-019 Approval Workflow Project phases requiring formal approval shall not advance until the required approval has been recorded. Audit & Compliance BR-020 Audit Logging All security-sensitive and business-critical actions shall be recorded in an immutable audit log. Examples include: • User authentication • Role changes • Report publication • AI prompt changes • Permission changes • File uploads • Invoice creation • Project approvals • Impersonation sessions BR-021 Audit Visibility Audit records may only be viewed by authorized users according to their assigned permissions. Notifications BR-022 Event-Driven Notifications Notifications shall only be generated in response to defined business events. Each notification must be linked to its originating event and recipient. Billing BR-023 Payment Confirmation No paid service shall become active until payment has been successfully confirmed by the payment provider. Technical Operations BR-024 Technical Operator Access Technical Operators shall receive configurable permissions defined by the Super Admin. Permissions are not fixed and may be granted, modified, or revoked at any time. Temporary access shall be supported. BR-025 Technical Operator Accountability Every action performed by a Technical Operator shall be logged with: • User identity • Timestamp • Action performed • Target resource • Result • Session information • Future Business Rules Additional business rules may be introduced in future platform versions. New rules shall never invalidate or conflict with existing approved business rules without formal revision of this specification. Automation BR-026 Workflow Automation The platform shall support automation of routine business workflows, including lead capture and routing, record creation, follow-up actions, notifications, and sales pipeline progression, when predefined business conditions are satisfied. Automated actions shall comply with all other Business Rules. Any action that would otherwise require human authorization under BR-008 or BR-009 shall not be automated unless explicitly permitted by platform configuration. Authorized users may override automated actions, and every automated action shall be recorded in the audit log in accordance with BR-020. C H A P T E R 5 5. Global User Roles & Permissions

Title: AI Scan Lifecycle
Requirement text: 9.5 AI Scan Lifecycle Every AI Scan shall follow the same mandatory lifecycle. No scan may bypass any required stage. Stage 1 – Purchase The customer selects an AI Scan package and completes payment. Payment must be successfully confirmed before the workflow continues. The platform shall allow: • Draft saving • Resume later • Validation of required fields • Secure submission • Stage 4 – AI Processing After submission, the AI Intelligence Layer analyzes the provided information. The AI may generate: • Operational insights • Automation opportunities • Risk observations • Business recommendations • Executive summary • Supporting analysis • The generated report remains an internal draft. • Stage 5 – Expert Review • An authorized IO SKY reviewer evaluates the AI- generated report. • The reviewer may: • Approve the report. • Request modifications. • Reject the draft. • Regenerate specific sections. • Add manual recommendations. • Edit customer-facing content. • The report remains unavailable to the customer during this stage. • Stage 6 – Publication Only after explicit approval by an authorized reviewer may the report be published. Publication shall: • Make the report visible in the Client Portal. • Trigger customer notifications. • Record audit events. • Create the first published version. • Stage 7 – Customer Access • After publication the customer may: • View the report. • Download the report. • Review recommendations. • Request a Discovery Call. • Continue into implementation services.
